item.description:
VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.92

  • Keeps Companion Realtime Voice on the streaming transport instead of silently falling back to the legacy turn-upload recorder after socket errors.
  • Adds streaming transport recovery so the iPhone can reconnect while preserving the live microphone session.
  • Avoids unnecessary HF runtime restarts during routine live settings updates.
  • Tightens Companion Realtime Voice planning so iPhone tools run only for clear phone/app/system actions, preventing spoken-only requests such as counting aloud from being misrouted to Maps.
  • Reports HF runtime startup and websocket failures accurately so setup problems do not appear as a ready voice session.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.91

  • Adds the HF-style Companion Realtime Voice runtime path with streaming STT, middle-brain, TTS, server VAD, and iPhone tool-call support.
  • Adds runtime readiness/install checks for Faster Whisper, Qwen3-TTS, local Qwen, and Cerebras middle-brain modes.
  • Improves Companion Realtime Voice startup reliability by launching cached HF models offline and surfacing early runtime failures promptly.
  • Improves packaging safeguards for notarized, Developer ID signed public releases.
